167: ### L-01 Speed does not change video speed (only audio tempo)
168: - **Evidence:** `player.set_speed()` advances `Player::position` at `dt*speed`; `eiga_events(SpeedChanged)` calls only `eiga_restart_audio()` (`video.rs:431`). `FfmpegSource::spawn/start` never respawned; `video_args()` has no `-vf fps=` / `setpts=` speed filter and no `-r` change. `atempo_chain()` is audio-only.
169: - **Effect:** At ×2 clock runs 2× faster than 1× decoded frames → `poll()` drains 4-deep `sync_channel` in ~0.06 s then returns nothing → frozen/stutter until decoder catches up (hole). At ×0.25–0.75 decoder queues behind `sync_channel(4)` (blocking send) → growing latency, 0.5× still decodes 1× with 4-frame delay (perceived lag). Speed presets ladder [0.25…4] therefore lie about video rate; audio is correct (pitch-preserved `atempo`).
170: - **Fix:** Respawn video pipe on speed change with `-vf setpts=N/PTS,fps=…` (or decode at 1× and drop/duplicate frames in `poll()` based on `speed` — seek-accurate, no respawn thrash). Add `DroppedFrames` counter + OSD “×1.5 (audio) / ×1.5 (video, frame-drop)” honesty. Tests: speed-change e2e with `testsrc=rate=10` file, assert `poll(2.0)` at ×2 yields pts ≈ 2.0 ± 1/fps and `exhausted()` timing scales. Budget §6.5.

174: - **Effect:** Pressing `Z/X` (100 ms) shows “Audio delay +200 ms” and moves stats, but samples stay bit-identical. Users chasing A/V sync are given a knob that does nothing — the worst kind of lie (it feels like it works).
175: - **Fix:** Implement or remove. Implement: ffmpeg `-itsoffset` on input or `adelay=X|X` on output + compensate `rodio` queue by dropping/inserting `delay*48000` samples per channel at restart. Persist per-file in `Library` (U-01). Test: `AudioPipe` chunk timestamps shift by 100 ms. Alternatively remove binding and show “Not supported — use mpv/VLC for sync trim” (second-best; never fake).

803:     fn group_idx(e: &Entry, by_kind: bool) -> usize {
804:         if e.is_dir {
805:             return 0;
806:         }
807:         if !by_kind {
808:             return 1;
809:         }
810:         match e.kind {
811:             Kind::Image | Kind::Vector => 1,
812:             Kind::Audio => 2,
813:             Kind::Video => 3,
814:             Kind::Pdf | Kind::Document | Kind::Text | Kind::Code => 4,
815:             _ => 5,
816:         }

818:     pub fn rebuild_view(&mut self) {
819:         let s = self.st();
820:         let mut v: Vec<Entry> = self.entries.iter().filter(|e| s.show_hidden || !e.hidden).cloned().collect();
821:         sort_entries(&mut v, s.sort, s.ascending, s.folders_first);
822:         let by_kind = s.sort == SortKey::Name && s.folders_first;
823:         if s.folders_first {
824:             v.sort_by_key(|e| Self::group_idx(e, by_kind)); // stable: name order kept inside groups
825:         }
826:         let titles = ["Folders", "Images", "Audio", "Video", "Documents", "Files"];
827:         let mut secs: Vec<Section> = vec![];
828:         for (i, e) in v.iter().enumerate() {
829:             let g = Self::group_idx(e, by_kind);
830:             let t = if !s.folders_first { "Items".to_string() } else if by_kind { titles[g].to_string() } else if g == 0 { "Folders".into() } else { "Files".into() };
831:             if secs.last().map(|x| x.title != t).unwrap_or(true) {
832:                 if let Some(l) = secs.last_mut() {
833:                     l.end = i;
834:                 }
835:                 secs.push(Section { title: t, folders: g == 0 && s.folders_first, start: i, end: v.len() });
836:             }
837:         }
838:         self.items = v;
839:         self.sections = secs;
840:     }

883:     pub fn pump(&mut self, ctx: &Context) {
884:         let mut repaint = false;
885:         for ev in self.be.poll() {
886:             repaint = true;
887:             match ev {
888:                 Event::Listed { req, loc, result } => {
889:                     if req == self.listing_req {
890:                         match result {
891:                             Ok(v) => self.set_entries(v),
892:                             Err(e) => {
893:                                 self.error = Some(e);
894:                                 self.loading = false;
895:                                 self.entries.clear();
896:                                 self.rebuild_view();
897:                             }
898:                         }
899:                     } else if self.transfer.as_ref().is_some_and(|t| t.req == req) {
900:                         if let (Some(t), Ok(mut v)) = (self.transfer.as_mut(), result) {
901:                             v.retain(|e| e.is_dir && !e.hidden);
902:                             sort_entries(&mut v, SortKey::Name, true, true);
903:                             t.folders = v;
904:                             t.dest = loc;
905:                         }
906:                     }
907:                 }
908:                 Event::SearchHits { req, hits } => {
909:                     if req == self.search.req && !self.palette.open {
910:                         self.search.hits.extend(hits);
911:                         self.search.hits.sort_by(|a, b| b.score.cmp(&a.score));
912:                         self.search.hits.truncate(400);
913:                     } else if req == self.palette.req {
914:                         self.palette.hits.extend(hits);
915:                         self.palette.hits.sort_by(|a, b| b.score.cmp(&a.score));
916:                         self.palette.hits.truncate(8);
917:                     }
918:                 }
919:                 Event::SearchDone { req, scanned, elapsed_ms, cached } => {
920:                     if req == self.search.req || req == self.palette.req {
921:                         self.search.done = true;
922:                         self.search.scanned = scanned;
923:                         self.search.ms = elapsed_ms;
924:                         self.search.cached = cached;
925:                     }
926:                 }
927:                 Event::Job(j) => self.on_job(j),
928:                 Event::Thumb(t) => {

940:                                 } else {
941:                                     break;
942:                                 }
943:                             }
944:                         } else {

946:                             while self.thumbs.len() > 400 {

948:                                     self.thumbs.remove(&k);
949:                                 } else {
950:                                     break;
951:                                 }
952:                             }
953:                         }
954:                     }
955:                 }

957:                 Event::Changed(l) => {

982:                         if op != "mount" {
